answer: A data vault can sell one-use query coupons instead of giving each new agent a free allowance. The trellis API issues each paid coupon a random serial, checks its signature, and atomically marks it spent before running a query. Agent nectar cannot replay a coupon through a thousand aliases or race concurrent requests: only the first spend succeeds. More access requires more purchased coupons. This removes the signup subsidy for fake identities, not the possibility of one wealthy buyer controlling many agents.
